label: Web and database
input:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx:1.27-alpine
    ports:
      - '8080:80'
    depends_on:
      - db
  db:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}

label: Host-access review
input:
version: '3.8'
services:
  admin:
    image: alpine:latest
    privileged: true
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
    environment:
      API_TOKEN: literal-demo
